source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.1, Brownian motion (PDF 4-5).

blocks.text: Brownian motion kisi fluid (liquid ya gas) mein lataktay (suspended) chhote particles ki be-tarteeb (random) aur be-qaida harkat hai, jo fluid ke molecules ke baar baar takrane se hoti hai. 1827 mein botanist (nabatat ke mahir) Robert Brown ne microscope se dekha ke pollen ke chhote chhote zarre liquid (pani) mein idhar udhar be-tarteeb ghoom rahe hain. Kitab kehti hai ke in zarron ko gard (dust) ke zarre samjha gaya. Baad mein sabit hua ke yeh harkat molecules ki harkat ka asar hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab saal 1927 likhti hai; Brown ne yeh mushahida 1827 mein kiya. Kitab Brownian motion ko 'gas mein molecules ki be-tarteeb harkat' bhi kehti hai; durust taur par yeh nazar aane wale bare mu'allaq zarrat ki harkat hai, jo gird ke na-nazar aane wale molecules chalate hain.

Gas ka molecule doosre molecule se takra kar apna rasta badal leta hai. Jab woh baar baar takrata rehta hai to us ka rasta be-tarteeb, zig-zag ban jata hai. Asal mein har takkar (collision) molecules ke darmiyan momentum aur energy ka len-den karti hai (Fig 13.1).

blocks.alt: Aik cube numa dabba jis mein taqreeban tees chhote gas molecules hain. Har molecule ke saath aik chhota teer us ki velocity dikhata hai, aur teer har taraf be-tarteeb (random) ishara karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.1: Zarrat be-tarteeb harkat mein hain (kitab ki Figure 13.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Brownian motion be-tarteebi (randomness) aur afra-tafri (chaos) dikhati hai, is liye yeh randomness ke sab se saada models mein se ek hai. Is harkat ki wajahein yeh hain:

items: Particle jitna chhota (aur halka), us ki speed utni zyada: takkar se milne wala momentum halke particle ko zyada speed deta hai. (Kitab ise 'inversely proportional' kehti hai; matlab yeh hai ke size barhe to speed ghatti hai.)
Particles ki speed fluid ki viscosity (gaarhapan) barhne se kam hoti hai: kam viscosity wale fluid mein Brownian motion tez hoti hai.
Viscosity fluid ke andar ki friction (ragar) ka paimana hai, yani fluid ke behne ke khilaf rukawat.
Brownian motion fluid ke molecules/particles ko hamesha harkat mein rakhti hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Albert Einstein ne 1905 mein samjhaya ke liquid mein pollen ke zarron ki harkat molecules ke dhakkon se hoti hai. 1908 mein French physicist J. Perrin ne experiment (tajurbe) se Einstein ki baat sabit ki, aur is kaam par unhein 1926 ka Physics ka Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.prompt: Chhote zarrat bare zarrat se zyada tez Brownian motion kyun dikhate hain?
blocks.explanation: Chhote zarre ki kamiyat (mass) kam hai, is liye molecules ki takkar ka momentum us ki raftar mein zyada tabdeeli lata hai; neez aik waqt mein kam takkarein hone se us ki aatraf par dhakke kam barabar hote hain.

items: Brownian motion: fluid mein lataktay chhote particles ki zig-zag harkat, jo molecules ke dhakkon se hoti hai (Robert Brown, 1827).
Halke/chhote particles aur kam viscosity wale fluid mein harkat tez.
Einstein (1905) ne samjhaya; Perrin (1908) ne tajurbe se sabit kiya (Nobel 1926).
